Ordinary Mystic
https://ordinarymysticreadings.com

Tarot and astrology readings, online, from reader Tyler Martin. Recorded
readings are prepared privately and delivered as a personalized video
walkthrough plus a written synthesis. Live readings happen one on one over
Zoom. Payment is by Stripe checkout at the price listed; Cash App and PayPal
are also accepted.

The practice serves three audiences: clients booking a reading, students who
will find teaching material here later, and readers using the free tools
(Querent, the digital tarot deck, Notion templates for tracking a practice).

## Readings

- Recorded, 15 minutes: $35. One question, looked at closely.
- Recorded, 30 minutes: $65. The standard session. A question from several
  angles, or two related ones.
- Recorded, 60 minutes: $125. Multiple questions and the connections between
  them.
- Live over Zoom, 15 minutes: $40. A focused sit-down for one question.
- Live over Zoom, 30 minutes: $100. The standard session. Room to follow the
  thread.
- Live over Zoom, 60 minutes: $195. A full hour, no rush, wherever the
  conversation goes.
- Ongoing readings: a standing arrangement with a regular cadence. Pricing
  depends on the cadence and starts with a conversation, not a checkout.

## TikTok live readings

Paid directly through https://ordinarymysticreadings.com/pay instead of
TikTok coins, for viewers of the live stream only.

- One card: $1 (wallets only, or 100 coins). A flash of intuition: closer to
  a hunch than an answer.
- Three cards: $5 (or 500 coins). The hunch, put to the test, from a couple
  of angles.
- Full spread: $15 (or 1,500 coins). A structure built for the question:
  a Celtic Cross for an overview, a Roundabout for advice on what to do
  next, a This or That for deciding between options.

## Pages

- https://ordinarymysticreadings.com/ : the hub, recorded readings first,
  live and ongoing, reviews, tools
- https://ordinarymysticreadings.com/tools : Notion templates and
  recommended tools for tracking a tarot or astrology practice
- https://ordinarymysticreadings.com/guides : guides to tarot and astrology,
  listed below
- https://ordinarymysticreadings.com/tulsa-tarot-reading : online tarot
  readings for people searching Tulsa, with a hand-off to Tulsa Tarot Reader
- https://ordinarymysticreadings.com/tulsa-astrology-reading : online
  astrology readings for people searching Tulsa
- https://ordinarymysticreadings.com/terms : terms of service
- https://ordinarymysticreadings.com/privacy : privacy policy
